name: High-Precision Real Time Clock
description: Like a battery-powered wristwatch for your Arduino! Never forgets the second, minute, or year even when unplugged.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a battery-powered wristwatch for your Arduino! Never forgets the second, minute, or year even when unplugged.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, SDA (Blue) to A4, and SCL (Blue) to A5.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to install the CR2032 backup battery, losing time when power is disconnected.
Using rechargeable batteries in RTC modules designed for non-rechargeable CR2032.

miniExperiment.title: Real-Time Clock Ticker
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, SDA to A4, SCL to A5.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor displays live real-time hours, minutes, and seconds advancing every second.
